answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12282 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalamualaikum 1-When Females go to sleep in sajdah why does there wuzu break and Males go to sleep in sajdah why isnt there wuzu broken,whats the reason? Question: Assalamualaikum 1-When Females go to sleep in sajdah why does there wuzu break and Males go to sleep in sajdah why isnt there wuzu broken,whats the reason? Answer ID: 12282 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 707/707=M/1430) The reason is that when a woman performs sajdah, her arms are rested on her stomach and thighs. This condition causes loosening of joints and it makes passing of wind more probable, so this will invalidate her wudhu. On the other hand, the condition of sajdah for men is different. Therefore, the ruling is different. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
